title: Novartis confirms 9 reported cases of tumors in patients treated with Zolgensma
snippet: Advocates are sounding the alarm on social media as they learn from their doctors that Novartis has received reports of tumors in patients who have been treated with the spinal muscular atrophy gene therapy.

title: RevMed’s Rasonque shatters analyst estimates with $198M quarter
snippet: Pent-up demand for the new pancreatic cancer therapy Rasonque helped RevMed soar past analysts’ sales expectations and reach 5,000 patients in the third quarter.

title: T-time: British biotech pours $133M into the pot for bispecifics
snippet: With backing from three Big Pharma investment arms, British biotech T-Therapeutics is brewing up a clinical launch for its cancer and autoimmune T cell engagers.

title: Evommune inks molecular glue deal worth $1.1B biobucks to fill pipeline gap
snippet: Evommune is commiting $30 million upfront for Hinova Pharmaceuticals’ oral molecular glue degrader—a low-cost bet with a high probability of success, according to analysts, after clinical failures roiled the biotech’s internal pipeline earlier this year.

title: Coveted metabolic gem Rhythm reportedly gets $10B offer from AstraZeneca
snippet: AstraZeneca has apparently made a $10 billion bid to acquire Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, an offer William Blair suspects will not be the last for the hot ticket metabolic biotech.

title: The top 12 companies hiring in biopharma now
snippet: Average jobs live on BioSpace increased year over year in October, a good sign for those eyeing a new position. If that’s you, check out the list of which companies are most actively looking to hire.

title: A treatment revolution is underway in MASH
snippet: To build on the momentum in MASH, we—at Madrigal Pharmaceuticals and the industry more widely—must further expand approaches to diagnosis, monitoring and individualized treatment to help more patients.

title: 1 in 5 have had multiple biopharma layoffs, poll finds
snippet: Biotech and pharma professionals share job hunt challenges after being let go, while a recruiting expert discusses why hiring managers prefer candidates without employment gaps and how to address gaps in interviews.
